recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中細胞呈間隔均勻的排列，每顆細胞中央為圓到橢圓形小核，四周圍著一圈透明淡染胞質，形成「荷包蛋（fried egg）」外觀，並散見褐色含鐵血黃素與紅血球滲出，符合毛細胞白血病浸潤。
features: Diffuse interstitial infiltrate of evenly spaced mononuclear cells
Round to oval or slightly indented nuclei with bland chromatin
Abundant clear to pale cytoplasm separating nuclei, producing a fried-egg appearance
Extravasated red cells in pink stroma (red cell lakes)
describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine shows a hypercellular marrow with a diffuse interstitial infiltrate of monotonous small to medium-sized cells. The cells have round to oval, sometimes indented nuclei with bland chromatin, and abundant clear cytoplasm that keeps the nuclei widely spaced, producing a characteristic fried-egg appearance. The background shows extravasated red cells and scattered hemosiderin. Findings are consistent with involvement by hairy cell leukemia; confirmation with CD20, annexin A1, CD25/CD123, and reticulin staining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are spindle or oval with granular cytoplasm, form paratrabecular or perivascular aggregates with fibrosis and eosinophils, and are tryptase and CD117 positive.
SMZL typically forms intrasinusoidal and nodular infiltrates of cells with less abundant cytoplasm rather than a diffuse widely spaced fried-egg pattern.

ddx.dx: Hypocellular myelodysplastic neoplasm or aplastic anemia
ddx.vs: These lack a monotonous lymphoid infiltrate; HCL can mimic hypocellularity, which is resolved by CD20 and annexin A1 IHC.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clockface chromatin and amphophilic cytoplasm rather than central nuclei with clear cytoplasm.
